# Counting Names

*The reed-lurkers of the Reedwater Bottoms have stopped the carts on the far road. Moth has an idea that breaks the old rule of the hat: save the best corners for outside traders. Clear the reed-lurkers, then take the idea to Rook as a question for the Table.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 40 [Reed-Lurker](../monsters/reed_lurker.md)
2. Talk to [Rook](../npcs/rook_tallow.md)

    - I have been thinking. At night, which is when I think. What if the hat kept the two best corners back, every night, for anybody who came in from outside? Brave enough to walk the roads, first pick of the market. It would bring them.
